about.text:
Ki-Lo program (KEY-623, part of KEY-6 scope 7 and 8, and the visible side of scope 6). Draft for Zee's review. Mobile only: every board shows dark and light, 390 pt wide. Screens that scroll are drawn at their full length and say so: program: default and program: settling at 1,800 pt with the 844 pt fold marked, program-edit: default at 1,840 and under-18 at 1,480. The expenditure-chart boards draw the card on its own; the screen boards show it in place. The label over each phone names its state.

Zee's rulings that shape the boards (KEY-604 and KEY-6, 23 Oct 2026, all recommended answers): Q1 the check-in day is the weekday the user set up on, the first check-in 14 days after, then weekly. Q2 one catch-up check-in per missed week, oldest first. Q3 the check-in uses the trend weight on the day before. Q4 a recalculation while settling restarts the estimate from the new answers; after a measurement it keeps the measured expenditure. Q5 an active programme's targets win, and saving your own targets ends the programme. Q6 an 80 % band, mu plus or minus 1.2816 sd. Q7 the hourly backstop (nothing to draw). Q8 the not-measured gate case is a window with fewer than 10 complete days. KEY-6 health data note: every estimate is labelled as an estimate (the Estimate badge, "Estimated expenditure", "likely"), and the programme screen, its no-program state and the explainer carry the not-medical-advice line of legal.ts, verbatim: "Ki-Lo's estimates and targets are not medical advice. Speak to a doctor before you make big changes to your diet or your weight."

Words: user-facing copy says "programme", the British spelling for a plan (open question 1). Code, routes and board headings keep "program".

Number rules: expenditure in whole kcal, as the setup estimate writes it (2,413; 2,580). The likely range is mu plus or minus 1.2816 x sqrt(var), each end to the nearest 10, written "Likely 2,430 to 2,730 kcal". Calorie targets to 10, macros in whole grams, kg a week to one decimal, an effective rate to two decimals (the setup guardrail lines' rule). Dates: "Friday 23 October" in sentences and headings, "Fri 30 Oct" in a row value.

People (made-up sample data, health data rule):
1. The golden fixture (Build Plan, Expenditure): prior 2,500 / 140,625, weight 80 - 0.05 d, intake 2,200 every day and every day complete, lose 0.5 %, BMR 1,755, moderate protein (1.6), balanced (fat 0.40). Started Friday 25 September 2026, so check-ins on Fridays 9, 16 and 23 October (days 14, 21, 28). The trend weight (alpha 0.10, bias-corrected) on the day before each: 79.592, 79.321, 79.023 kg. program: default is Friday 23 October, the morning of the third check-in.
2. The setup canvas's sample man (male, 35, 180 cm, 80.0 kg, lightly active, lose 0.5 %, moderate, balanced): set up on Friday 23 October; program: settling is drawn on Wednesday 28 October.
3. Two guardrail people: the setup canvas's max-deficit man (male, 40, 175 cm, 130.0 kg, moderately active, lose 1.0 %) and ADR 0002 Amendment 1's floor-above-expenditure woman (50, 150 cm, 40.0 kg, sedentary), drawn with lose 0.5 %. Their check-in measurements (z and R_eff) are invented for the board and stated; every number after them follows the rules.

Authority, highest first: Zee's rulings on Linear, ADR 0002 Amendments 1 and 2 (KEY-604), the Ki-Lo Design System, the approved M5 boards (weight, trend-explainer) and the setup canvas, the built mobile kit on main, MacroFactor (design-reference/macrofactor.md verifies no programme or expenditure screen, so no layout here is borrowed from it), then ticket prose.

Not drawn, on purpose: web boards, day-of-week targets, training switches (KEY-338), a check-in weekday picker, push notifications.

questions.text:
Open questions for Zee, each with the recommended answer (drawn as recommended).

1. "Programme" or "Program" in the app's words. Drawn: "Programme" (British English for a plan; the design system writes British English). Code, routes and board names stay "program". Recommended: Programme.

2. The settling weeks on the chart. Before the first check-in no snapshot is written for the second week, so the chart would break after the first point. Drawn: the start snapshot is carried into the settling week (the belief does not change before the first check-in: no process step runs). A week is a gap only when there is truly no estimate (between an ended programme and a new one). Recommended: carry it.

3. Expenditure rounding. Drawn: whole kcal (2,580; 2,413, as the approved setup estimate), with the range to the nearest 10. Alternative: everything to the nearest 10 (2,410 would then differ from the setup board). Recommended: whole kcal.

4. The diary toast after an on-open check-in (P9). Drawn: "Check-in done: new targets" with "See why" (opens Programme) and the complete haptic, the design system's "check-in applied" moment. It shows only when the calorie target changed. Recommended: yes. Alternative: no toast, as the setup canvas chose for first run.

5. The switch-to-manual dialog's tone. Drawn: primary ("Save my targets" first, "Keep my programme" second). Nothing is deleted and Estimate my targets starts a programme again. Recommended: primary. Alternative: destructive (red confirm).

6. Guardrail lines when several clamps are recorded. Drawn: one line per clamp code, except that of max_deficit, max_surplus, floor and profile_max only the one that set the final number gets a line (the setup canvas's rule: the floor's line shows when it and the deficit cap both apply), so two lines never contradict. Order: step clamp, max_rate, the calorie clamp, dow_floor, macro_fit. Recommended: as drawn.

7. Where the More row sits. Drawn: Programme in Nutrition, under Targets (it sets them). Alternative: in Body beside Weight. Recommended: Nutrition.

8. The Programme icon. Drawn: Lucide ChartLine, added to the icon map (the kit has no chart icon; Flame already means calories). Recommended: ChartLine.

9. The likely range while settling. Drawn: shown (1,950 to 2,880, wide on purpose). Alternative: hide it until the first measurement. Recommended: show it, because it is the honest state of the estimate.

10. Edit programme as one scrolling form of four option groups (drawn) or as rows that each open a setup step. Recommended: one form, Save once.

11. Saving in Edit programme lands back on Programme with the Toast "Targets saved" (the existing string). Recommended: as described; not drawn because the Programme screen and Toast are drawn elsewhere.

n1.text:
Entry and programme screen notes (P3).

more · program-row. The More screen as built on main (Food; Nutrition; Body; Settings: Appearance, Reminders, About; Account), with one new row in Nutrition, under Targets: ListRow, icon ChartLine, "Programme". Subtitle with a programme: "Next check-in Fri 30 Oct"; without: "Let Ki-Lo set your targets". The Targets row's subtitle becomes "From your programme" while a programme runs (MORE_SCREEN gains the string; "Set by you" otherwise), its value the current target, 2,140 kcal. Names: "Programme, next check-in Fri 30 Oct"; "Targets, from your programme, 2,140 kcal". Both rows open their screens; Programme opens app/(tabs)/more/program. Ship visible: the row is on from P3's merge.

program: default (golden fixture, Friday 23 October, after the third check-in). Header: Back ("Back to More"), title "Programme". Top to bottom:
1. Expenditure card: eyebrow "Estimated expenditure", Badge accent "Estimate"; 2,580 "kcal a day" in the 40 pt numeral of the M5 trend weight card; "Likely 2,430 to 2,730 kcal"; caption "From your weigh-ins and food log, updated Friday 23 October". Name: "Estimated expenditure, 2,580 kilocalories a day, likely 2,430 to 2,730 kcal".
2. This week's targets card: eyebrow "This week's targets", "Since Fri 23 Oct"; 2,140 "kcal a day"; the rate line "To lose about 0.4 kg a week (0.5% of your weight)." (lb for imperial users: 0.9 lb); the setup estimate card's three tiles, Protein 126 g, Carbohydrate 245 g, Fat 73 g; a row with the Calendar icon, "Next check-in" / "In 7 days, then every Friday" / "Fri 30 Oct". When a guardrail set the target, the rate line is replaced by its guardrail line (see the summary notes).
3. Last check-in card (CheckinSummaryCard): eyebrow "Last check-in", "Friday 23 October", Badge "Measured"; rows "Expenditure: 2,574 to 2,580 kcal", "Calorie target: 2,140 kcal, no change"; the data line "From your weight trend and the food you logged: 28 weigh-ins and 28 complete days in the last 4 weeks."
4. Expenditure by week (ExpenditureChartCard, see the chart notes).
5. "Your programme": Goal, Lose weight; Rate, 0.5% a week, "About 0.4 kg a week"; Protein, Moderate, "1.6 g per kg, about 126 g a day"; Diet style, Balanced. Information rows, no chevron.
6. Edit programme (Pencil, opens program-edit) and How it works (Info, opens the sheet).
7. The not-medical-advice line, muted caption.
Motion: the first open after a check-in counts the hero numeral from the old value and flashes the accent (kl-flash), and the check-in card cuts in (kl-cut-in), with the complete haptic; reduce motion fades.

Arithmetic. Hero: mu 2,579.54, sd sqrt(13,449.0) = 115.97, 1.2816 x 115.97 = 148.62, so 2,430.9 to 2,728.2, written 2,430 to 2,730. Targets: delta 0.005 x 79.023 x 7,700 / 7 = 434.6; raw 2,579.54 - 434.6 = 2,144.9, rounded 2,140; the 30 % bound 1,805.7 and the floor max(1,200, 0.9 x 1,755 = 1,579.5) are not reached. Protein 1.6 x 79.023 = 126.4, 126 g; fat 0.40 x (2,140 - 505.8) / 9 = 72.6, 73 g; carbohydrate 0.60 x 1,634.2 / 4 = 245.1, 245 g (the KEY-604 end-to-end gate). Rate 0.005 x 79.02 = 0.40 kg. Check-in card: the second snapshot 2,574.22 (2,574) to 2,579.54 (2,580); the second check-in's target was 2,574.22 - 0.005 x 79.321 x 1,100 = 2,138.0, so 2,140: no change. 28 weigh-ins and 28 complete days are days 0 to 27, the whole window. Next check-in 23 Oct + 7 = 30 Oct.

program: settling (the setup sample man, Wednesday 28 October). The hero adds Badge warning "Settling": 2,413, "Likely 1,950 to 2,880 kcal", "A starting estimate from your answers. Your first check-in measures it." Under it the trend explainer's compact warning Banner: "First check-in Friday 6 November, in 9 days" / "Until then your targets stay as they are. The check-in needs:" and three progress rows (SettlingProgressBar, extended): "Days with a weigh-in, 4 of 8"; "Days your weigh-ins cover, first to last, 6 of 14"; "Complete days, 4 of 10"; then the tip "Weigh in on Thursday 5 November, the day before, so your weigh-ins cover the full 14 days." The tip shows only while the cover can still be met and is not met yet. Targets as the setup estimate (1,970; P 128, C 219, F 65), "First check-in" / "In 9 days, then every Friday" / "Fri 6 Nov". No check-in card yet. The chart has two points.
Arithmetic: BMR 1,755.0, mu 1,755 x 1.375 = 2,413.125 (2,413), var (0.15 x 2,413.125)^2 = 131,021.4, sd 361.97, 1.2816 x sd = 463.9: 1,949.2 to 2,877.0, written 1,950 to 2,880. First check-in 23 Oct + 14 = Friday 6 Nov, 9 days after 28 Oct. Its window is 9 Oct to 5 Nov. Weigh-ins so far on 23 (the wizard's), 25, 27 and 28 Oct: 4 of 8 days, covering 23 to 28 Oct = 6 of 14 days. Complete days 23, 24, 26 and 27 Oct: 4 of 10 (today is not complete yet). The weigh-ins can only cover 14 days with one on 5 Nov (23 Oct + 13), the window's last day. The counts are the window's, so readings logged before setup count too.

program: no-program (a user on their own targets). EmptyState with points: ChartLine tile, "Let Ki-Lo set your targets", "A programme sets your calorie and macro targets from your goal, then checks them each week."; three rows: "Estimates the energy you use, from a few questions about you." (Calculator), "Checks that estimate each week against your weigh-ins and food log." (Scale), "Adjusts your calorie and macro targets to keep you on pace for your goal." (Target); Button primary lg "Estimate my targets" opens /setup?mode=recalculate (the setup canvas's recalculate flow); under it "Your own targets (2,200 kcal a day) stay until you start." (the user's own number, the M3 sample's); the not-medical-advice line.

program: loading. Skeletons in the cards' shapes after the 200 ms skeleton delay; named "Loading your programme". program: error. ErrorState: "Couldn't load your programme" / "Check your connection and try again. Your targets have not changed." / Button secondary "Try again". No raw error text.

Accessible names: the cards are named by their eyebrow and value; the progress bars by "Days with a weigh-in, 4 of 8" and so on; the rows read title, subtitle, value.

n2.text:
Check-in summary notes (P4). The CheckinSummaryCard sits on the programme screen under this week's targets; these boards show the screen scrolled to it (the expenditure card is above, out of view), with the card marked by a dashed outline. Its parts: eyebrow "Last check-in", the date, Badge "Measured" (neutral) or "Not measured" (warning); two rows, Expenditure and Calorie target, each "A to B kcal", "A kcal, no change" or "A kcal, carried forward"; then the lines: data (CircleCheck), guardrail (Info), reason (CircleAlert in warning ink), plain (indented). Name: "Last check-in, Friday 9 October, measured".

checkin-summary: measured (golden day 14, Friday 9 October). "Expenditure: 2,500 to 2,560 kcal"; "Calorie target: 2,060 to 2,120 kcal"; "From your weight trend and the food you logged: 14 weigh-ins and 14 complete days in the last 4 weeks." Targets card 2,120, P 127, C 242, F 72.
Arithmetic: z = 2,200 - (-0.05 x 7,700) = 2,585; P = 140,625 + 75^2 = 146,250; R_eff 62,467.8; K = 0.70071; step 0.70071 x 85 = 59.56, not capped; mu 2,559.56 (2,560). Start target: 2,500 - 0.005 x 80.0 x 1,100 = 2,060. New: 2,559.56 - 0.005 x 79.592 x 1,100 = 2,121.8, so 2,120; P 1.6 x 79.592 = 127.3, 127; F 0.40 x (2,120 - 509.4) / 9 = 71.6, 72; C 0.60 x 1,610.6 / 4 = 241.6, 242.

checkin-summary: guardrail. Two cases and the copy specimen.
A, the step cap and the deficit cap (max-deficit man, check-in Friday 9 October). "Expenditure: 3,408 to 3,158 kcal"; "Calorie target: 2,390 to 2,220 kcal"; the data line; "Your expenditure moved 250 kcal, the most it moves in one week. Your weigh-ins and food log pointed to a 415 kcal drop, so it may move again at your next check-in."; "Kept to a 30% deficit, the most Ki-Lo sets. You would lose about 0.9 kg a week (0.66% of your weight), not 1.0%." The targets card shows the same deficit line in place of the rate line.
Arithmetic: BMR 1,300 + 1,093.75 - 200 + 5 = 2,198.75; mu 2,198.75 x 1.55 = 3,408.06, var (0.15 x 3,408.06)^2 = 261,335.0. Invented measurement z 2,900, R_eff 60,000. P 266,960.0; K 266,960.0 / 326,960.0 = 0.81649; raw step 0.81649 x (2,900 - 3,408.06) = -414.8, capped at -250; mu 3,158.06 (3,158), var (1 - K) x P = 48,989.5 (likely 2,870 to 3,440). Trend weight 128.4 kg: delta 0.01 x 128.4 x 1,100 = 1,412.4; raw 1,745.7; the 30 % bound 0.7 x 3,158.06 = 2,210.6 sets it, 2,210 is below it so it steps up to 2,220 (max_deficit); the floor max(1,200, 1,978.9) is below. Pace (3,158.06 - 2,220) x 7 / 7,700 = 0.853 kg a week, 0.66 % of 128.4. Start target 2,390 (the setup canvas). Macros P 205, F 64 (the 0.5 g/kg floor, 64.2), C 205.
B, the floor above expenditure (ADR 0002 Amendment 1, deriveTargets point 3), check-in Friday 9 October. "Expenditure: 1,112 to 1,094 kcal"; "Calorie target: 1,200 kcal, no change"; the data line; "Raised to 1,200 kcal, the lowest target Ki-Lo sets for you. That is more than your estimated expenditure of 1,094 kcal, so you would gain about 0.1 kg a week (0.24% of your weight), not lose it."; then, plain, "Talk to a doctor or dietitian before you try to lose more weight."
Arithmetic: BMR 400 + 937.5 - 250 - 161 = 926.5; mu 926.5 x 1.2 = 1,111.8, var 27,812.2. Invented z 1,080, R_eff 25,000. P 33,437.2; K 0.57219; step 0.57219 x (1,080 - 1,111.8) = -18.2; mu 1,093.6 (1,094), var 14,304.8 (likely 940 to 1,250). Trend 39.9 kg: delta 219.5, raw 874.2; the floor max(1,200, 833.9) = 1,200 is above mu, so 1,200 (floor). Effective (1,093.6 - 1,200) x 7 / 7,700 = -0.097 kg a week (gain 0.1 kg), -0.097 / 39.9 = -0.24 %. P 1.6 x 39.9 = 63.8, 64; F 0.40 x (1,200 - 255.4) / 9 = 42.0, 42; C 141.7, 142. Rate row 0.005 x 39.9 = 0.2 kg.
The specimen phone lists every line with its code (templates and arithmetic):
- expenditure step clamp, drop: "Your expenditure moved 250 kcal, the most it moves in one week. Your weigh-ins and food log pointed to a {raw} kcal drop, so it may move again at your next check-in." {raw} is |rawStepKcal| rounded (415 above). Rise: the same with "rise"; 284 is a woman at 1,111.8 / 27,812.2 with an invented z 1,650 and R_eff 30,000: K 0.52710, 0.52710 x 538.2 = 283.7.
- max_rate: "Set to 1.0% a week, the fastest Ki-Lo sets for losing weight." Gain: "Set to 0.5% a week, the fastest Ki-Lo sets for gaining weight." (Build Plan golden: 1.5 % clamped to 1.0.)
- max_deficit: "Kept to a 30% deficit, the most Ki-Lo sets. You would lose about {kg} kg a week ({pct}% of your weight), not {rate}%." (case A).
- max_surplus: "Kept to a 20% surplus, the most Ki-Lo sets. You would gain about {kg} kg a week ({pct}% of your weight), not {rate}%." Example tdee 1,800, 70 kg, gain 0.5 %: delta 385, raw 2,185, bound 2,160; (2,160 - 1,800) x 7 / 7,700 = 0.33 kg, 0.47 %.
- floor: "Raised to {floor} kcal, the lowest target Ki-Lo sets for you. You would lose about {kg} kg a week ({pct}% of your weight), not {rate}%." Example: the setup canvas's floor woman, 0.26 kg, 0.47 %, not 1.0 %.
- floor above expenditure: case B, and the plain line after it.
- dow_floor: "Some days were raised to {floor} kcal, the lowest daily target Ki-Lo sets for you." Example floor 1,579.5 rounded up to 1,580. Day-of-week targets have no UI in v1, so this line exists for completeness.
- macro_fit: "Protein was lowered to {p} g so that it fits in {kcal} kcal with the least fat Ki-Lo sets ({fat} g). Carbohydrate is 0 g." Example 1,200 kcal at 160 kg: fat floor 80 g = 720 kcal, protein (1,200 - 720) / 4 = 120 g.
- profile_max: "Capped at 6,000 kcal, the most Ki-Lo sets. You would gain about {kg} kg a week ({pct}% of your weight), not {rate}%." Example tdee 5,600, 140 kg, gain 0.5 %: raw 6,370, the 20 % bound 6,720 is not reached, 6,000; (6,000 - 5,600) x 7 / 7,700 = 0.36 kg, 0.26 %.
Only one of max_deficit, max_surplus, floor and profile_max is written: the one that set the number (open question 6).

checkin-summary: not-measured. Badge "Not measured"; "Expenditure: 2,500 kcal, carried forward"; "Calorie target: 2,060 kcal, no change"; one reason line per code, in the order span, weigh_days, complete_days; then "So your expenditure estimate was carried forward, and it is less certain: likely 2,010 to 2,990 kcal. Your targets were worked out again from it." The targets card keeps its rate line.
Left, the gate (Q8): the golden day-14 check-in with 9 complete days: "You completed 9 days. A check-in needs at least 10 complete days in the last 4 weeks." Right: weigh-ins on days 5, 6, 8, 11 and 13 only: "Your weigh-ins cover 9 days, first to last. A check-in needs them to cover at least 14." and "You weighed in on 5 days. A check-in needs at least 8 in the last 4 weeks."
Arithmetic: no measurement, so mu stays 2,500 and var = 140,625 + 75^2 = 146,250, sd 382.43, 1.2816 x sd = 490.1: 2,009.9 to 2,990.1, written 2,010 to 2,990. Targets re-derived at the trend weight on day 13: 2,500 - 0.005 x 79.592 x 1,100 = 2,062.2 (right: 79.515 kg, 2,062.7), both 2,060; P 127, F 69, C 233. Span 13 - 5 + 1 = 9.

n3.text:
How it works and chart notes (P5, P6, P2).

program-explainer: how it works. BottomSheet with TrendExplainerSheet's structure (handle, h2, Done in accent ink, sections of body-strong titles over 14/21 secondary text, the note last). Title "How your programme works". Drawn at the top and scrolled to the end. Sections:
"Your expenditure": "The energy you use in a day. Ki-Lo works it out from the food you log and how your weight trend moves: if your trend holds steady while you eat 2,000 kcal a day, you use about 2,000."
"The weekly check-in": "Every Friday, the day you started, Ki-Lo looks back over the last 4 weeks. It updates your expenditure, then sets the next week's targets from it. If you have been away, it catches up one week at a time." (the person's weekday)
"The first two weeks": "Your first check-in is two weeks after you start. Until then your expenditure is a starting estimate from your answers, and your targets stay as they are."
"What a check-in needs": "In the last 4 weeks: weigh-ins on at least 8 days, covering at least 14 days from the first to the last, and at least 10 complete days. Without them the estimate is carried forward and becomes less certain, and your targets are worked out again from it."
"The likely range": "Your expenditure comes with a range. The true figure is inside it 8 times in 10. The range narrows as you weigh in and complete your days."
"Guardrails": "Your expenditure moves by at most 250 kcal a week. Your target is never more than 30% below it or 20% above it, and never above 6,000 kcal. When you are losing weight it is never below 1,200 kcal or 90% of the energy you use at rest, whichever is higher. When a guardrail changes your target, the check-in says so."
"Water, glycogen and muscle" (the energy density caveat, Build Plan): "Ki-Lo counts 7,700 kcal for each kilogram your trend moves, which assumes the change is mostly fat. In the first weeks of a new deficit you also lose water and glycogen, so your weight falls faster and your expenditure can look higher than it is. If you gain mostly muscle, a kilogram holds less energy, so your expenditure can look lower than it is."
Then the not-medical-advice line. Done closes; the sheet scrolls on a small phone. Name: the dialog by its title.

expenditure-chart: default, few-points, empty (ExpenditureChartCard: Card + LineChart with the band). LineChart label "Expenditure by week", unit "kcal a day"; one point per week (the Monday of the week of each snapshot, oldest first, up to 12 weeks); the band per point is the likely range; the legend "Estimate" (line) and "Likely range" (band swatch); the summary sentence under it, which is also the chart's accessible name.
Default (golden fixture, 5 weeks): 21 Sep 2,500 (start, 2,019.4 to 2,980.6: 1.2816 x 375 = 480.6); 28 Sep 2,500 carried (open question 2); 5 Oct 2,559.56 (sd 209.22, 2,291.4 to 2,827.7); 12 Oct 2,574.22 (sd 144.70, 2,388.8 to 2,759.7); 19 Oct 2,579.54 (2,430.9 to 2,728.2). Axis: the value domain runs from the lowest to the highest of the values and band ends, so the ticks are 2,980, 2,500, 2,020 (to the nearest 10). Week labels every second week back from the latest (LineChart's thinning to 4): 19 Oct, 5 Oct, 21 Sep. Summary: "Estimated expenditure over 5 weeks: 2,500 kcal a day in the week of 21 September, 2,580 now, likely 2,430 to 2,730."
Few points: settling, two weeks (19 and 26 Oct, 2,413 carried, 1,949.2 to 2,877.0): "Estimated expenditure over 2 weeks: 2,413 kcal a day, a starting estimate from your answers, likely 1,950 to 2,880." One week (Saturday 24 October): a single point with its band as a 12 pt bar: "Estimated expenditure this week: 2,413 kcal a day, a starting estimate from your answers, likely 1,950 to 2,880."
Empty: no snapshot yet (the moment between Save in setup and the first recompute, or a history read that came back empty): the card keeps its label and shows "No estimates yet" / "Your expenditure shows here week by week, starting from your setup answers." A failed read shows the screen's error state instead.

n4.text:
Edit programme notes (P7). Route app/(tabs)/more/program-edit, opened from "Edit programme". SheetHeader "Edit programme" with Close on the right (as the setup recalculate); Close leaves without saving and without a confirm. One scrolling form of the setup canvas's OptionCards, prefilled from the programme:
"Goal": Lose weight, "Eat a little less than you use."; Maintain weight, "Eat about what you use."; Gain weight, "Eat a little more than you use."; under them always the info Banner "Pregnant or breastfeeding?" / "Talk to a doctor, midwife or dietitian before you set a goal. Ki-Lo's estimates do not allow for pregnancy or breastfeeding."
"Rate" / "As a share of your body weight each week. Slower is easier to keep up.": the setup rate cards, valued at the trend weight 79.02 kg: 0.2, 0.4 (0.5 %, Suggested, chosen), 0.6, 0.8 kg a week (pct / 100 x 79.02, one decimal). Gain shows the setup gain cards. Maintain hides the group.
"Protein" / "Set first, from your weight. Fat and carbohydrate share the rest.": Moderate 126 g (chosen), High 158 g, Very high 174 g (1.6, 2.0, 2.2 x 79.02, whole grams).
"Diet style" / "How the calories left after protein are split between fat and carbohydrate.": Balanced (chosen), Low fat, Low carb, the setup descriptions.
Footer: "Saving changes your targets from today. Your expenditure estimate stays at 2,580 kcal a day." (Amendment 2 point 7: a recompute keeps the newest snapshot's mu and only rederives targets) and Button primary lg "Save changes".

program-edit: under-18. goalsAllowed(age) from @keylow/core/setup: Lose is disabled with "Not offered under 18." (named "Lose weight, not offered under 18"), the banner becomes "Talk to a health professional" / "If you are under 18 and want to lose weight, or you are pregnant or breastfeeding, talk to a doctor, midwife or dietitian first.", Maintain is chosen, so no Rate group. The golden person drawn at 16 (born 2 June 2010).
program-edit: saving. Save keeps its width, hides its label and shows the kit spinner, aria-busy; Close is dimmed and does nothing; one save per press. program-edit: save-error. The error Banner, sentence only, above the footnote: "Not saved. Check your connection and try again." (SAVE_FAILED_BANNER). Save is the retry; the choices stay. Both drawn scrolled to the end.
After a save: back to Programme with the new targets and the Toast "Targets saved".

n5.text:
Targets, diary and setup notes (P8, P9, and the setup canvas's recalculate).

targets · engine. Targets while a programme is active (useTargets reports source engine, KEY-617). New parts outlined. A ListRow "Programme" / "Your weekly check-in sets these targets" (ChartLine, chevron, opens Programme). "This week", "Since Friday 23 October", and read-only value rows with the macro colour keys: Calories 2,140 kcal; Protein 126 g; Carbohydrate 245 g; Fat 73 g (the golden fixture after its third check-in). The setup canvas's "Estimate my targets" row, unchanged (a recalculation: Q4). The note "Your programme sets these each week. If you set your own, the weekly check-in stops." replaces TARGETS_NOTE for programme users. Footer Button secondary lg "Set my own targets": it opens the existing Targets form, prefilled with this week's numbers.

targets · switch-to-manual. The form after "Set my own targets": Calories typed as 2000 over the prefilled 2,140; Protein 126, Carbohydrate 245, Fat 73; "Macros add up to 2,141 kcal" (126 x 4 + 245 x 4 + 73 x 9); the note "Saving your own targets ends your programme and its weekly check-in." Save opens the ConfirmDialog, tone primary: "Turn off weekly check-ins?" / "Saving your own targets ends your programme, so Ki-Lo stops adjusting them each week. You can start one again from Estimate my targets." / "Save my targets" / "Keep my programme". Keep changes nothing and returns to the form. Save my targets saves (ending the programme, ended_on today, Q5), returns to More's Targets with the Toast "Targets saved", and the diary shows the typed numbers. A user without a programme never sees the dialog.

diary · targets-updated (optional, P9; open question 4). The M4 Diary as built, Friday 23 October, breakfast logged, the ring and strip now on 2,140 kcal (P 126, C 245, F 73). The Toast, neutral, RefreshCw: "Check-in done: new targets" with the action "See why" (opens Programme). Shown once, after CheckinRunner reports ran > 0 and the calorie target changed; not shown for a catch-up that leaves the target as it was. Complete haptic. The toast is the only new thing on the board.

setup: estimate · measured. The setup canvas's estimate in recalculate mode (Close on the right, CTA "Save targets", as its notes say), after the engine has measured (ADR 0002 Amendment 2 point 6): the ListRow reads "Estimated expenditure" / "Measured from your weigh-ins and food log", 2,580 kcal, and the accuracy line is "Ki-Lo measured your expenditure at your last check-in, on Friday 23 October. Changing your answers keeps it and changes only your targets." Drawn with the golden fixture changing the rate to 0.25 %: delta 0.0025 x 79.02 x 1,100 = 217.3, raw 2,362.2, 2,360; P 126; F 0.40 x (2,360 - 505.7) / 9 = 82.4, 82 g; C 0.60 x 1,854.3 / 4 = 278.1, 278 g; "To lose about 0.2 kg a week (0.25% of your weight)." (0.0025 x 79.02 = 0.198). While settling, the recalculation shows the setup canvas's own estimate boards, unchanged, because the estimate restarts from the new answers (Q4). Drawn here, in a copy of the setup canvas's SetupScreen with this one state added, so the approved setup canvas is untouched.

n6.text:
Components notes (P2 and the audit). Every component is reused, extended or new as listed; the screen tickets' audit against main follows this.

LineChart, extended (P2). New optional props: band, one { low, high } or null per point (null for a week with no value; existing callers pass nothing and nothing changes), and legend, { line, band } labels (drawn only with a band). With a band: the value domain runs from the lowest to the highest of the values and band ends (valueDomain over both), the band is a shaded area in --chart-band through each point's low and high, under the line, breaking at a null as the line does; a lone week's band is a 12 pt bar centred on its point; the legend row sits under the week labels, then the caller's summary. The axis formatter is the caller's (the expenditure card rounds to 10 with a thousands separator). Line, points and marker as built (--chart-trend, --chart-point, --chart-marker; the latest week is the marker). Drawn states: band over 5 weeks, a week with no value, without band (as built, the ExerciseProgressView caller's look), and on the chart boards one and two points. The band's colour is the existing token, so no new token.

New pieces: CheckinSummaryCard (Card, Badge, rows, lines), its line kinds (data, guardrail, reason, plain) reusing the setup canvas's guardrail line layout; the band legend (part of LineChart); SettlingProgressBar's generalisation (label, count of a target, name; warning fill on the raised track, 6 pt), moved to components/ui; ExpenditureChartCard (Card + LineChart + EmptyState); ProgramScreen, ProgramExplainerSheet, ProgramEditScreen (compositions).

Component audit.
Reused as built: Card, ListRow, GroupedList, Button (primary, secondary, ghost), Badge (accent, warning, neutral), Banner (info, error; the compact warning of the trend explainer), BottomSheet and SheetHeader, ConfirmDialog (tone primary), Toast (with action and icon), Skeleton, ErrorState, EmptyState, Text, Icon (Calendar, Pencil, Info, Target, Scale, Calculator from the setup canvas, RefreshCw, ChevronRight, X), NumericInput, TabBar, ScreenHeader; the setup kit's OptionCard (S2) and the setup estimate card's macro tiles; TrendExplainerSheet's structure for the explainer; the More screen and the M4 diary as built.
Extended: LineChart (band, legend, domain); SettlingProgressBar (generic label and count, moved to ui; the trend explainer's call keeps its words through defaults); TargetsScreen (the engine state and the confirm on save); MORE_SCREEN copy (the Programme row, the Targets subtitle); the setup estimate (the measured subtitle and accuracy line, the CTA by mode); the icon map (+ ChartLine).
New: ProgramScreen, CheckinSummaryCard, ExpenditureChartCard, ProgramExplainerSheet, ProgramEditScreen.
Not used, and why: StatCard (the finish screen's third-of-a-row card with a 20 pt numeral; the hero needs the 40 pt numeral, two badges and two lines, so it is a Card in the M5 trend weight card's layout); MacroBars (eaten against target; the programme shows targets alone, so the setup estimate's tiles); CalorieRing, SegmentedControl, ChipGroup; ProgressBar (the 4 pt accent bar; settling uses the warning bar of the trend explainer).
